title: Reefer Cargo Services: Terminal Plug-In Rates, Free Days and Contract Discount
content:
While a laden reefer waits at a terminal it is kept on power and watched, and Reefer Cargo Services prices that stay per day, separately for the load terminal and the discharge terminal. Each tier grants a number of free days at each end and names the service contract standing that earns a reduction on these fees. Rates are in US dollars per day.

## Daily rates and free days

| Tier | Load terminal rate | Discharge terminal rate | Free days at load | Free days at discharge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 48.00 | 52.00 | 0 | 0 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 55.00 | 60.00 | 0 | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 60.00 | 65.00 | 1 | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 70.00 | 75.00 | 1 | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 95.00 | 100.00 | 2 | 2 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 120.00 | 130.00 | 0 | 0 |

## Contract holder reduction

| Tier | Lowest service contract tier rank that qualifies | Reduction on plug-in fees (%) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 0 (no reduction offered) | 0 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 4 | 5 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 4 | 5 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 4 | 10 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 4 | 10 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 4 | 5 |

A qualifying rank of 0 means the tier grants no plug-in reduction to anyone. On the other five tiers the threshold is rank 4 on the service contract ladder.

## Quick comparisons

- The discharge-end rate is higher than the load-end rate on every tier.
- Standard and Superfreezer grant no free day at either terminal; Pharma GDP grants two at each.
- Monitored is the only tier whose free days differ between the two ends: none at load, one at discharge.
